dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I'm sorry for the trouble I caused you and the Grand Master. Just thinking about how I behaved back then... I wish I could give myself a slap in the face!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: How did I not understand? The only way to make up for my mistakes was to make Glory happy.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If neither lies nor truths could do that... I should have seen that there was only one thing left for me to do — become someone capable of giving her happiness.
